newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Nov department store sales fall 1.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Nov department store sales fall 1.8 pct.

text.p: Mexico's same-store department store sales fell 1.8 percent in November from the same month a year earlier, industry association ANTAD said in a statement.
It said that same-store supermarket sales fell 1.7 percent in November from the same month a year earlier.
The decline in sales for supermarkets and department stores was the lowest since last June in both categories.
But the association said part of the improvement was due to the fact that there were five Saturdays during November versus four Saturdays in November 1995.
